doc.title: Deployment Gate Decision: Meridian Release Train

segments.exact:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

circumstance.context: Deployment gate decision for the Meridian release train

segments.note: Announces a new binding requirement/policy — declarative rather than mere assertion, since it establishes the gate.

segments.exact:
We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

circumstance.context: Deployment gate decision for the Meridian release train

segments.note: States the factual justification for the gate.

segments.exact: **Gate**: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys
segments.note: Editorial summary restating Quinton's own ratified rule; kept attributed to him as the decision's substance, consistent with the quoted declaration above.
States ownership of the gate decision.
